en: Bill
Hey there, Celio! Long time no see.
text: Salut, Celio! Ce mult a trecut!

en: Celio
Bill! You really came all the way out here? I can't believe it!
text: Bill! Chiar ai venit până aici? Nu-mi vine să cred!

en: Bill
This is {player}. A real up-and-coming trainer, beat every Gym Leader in Kanto. Came along to keep me company.
text: Ăsta e {player}. Un Antrenor în plină ascensiune, a învins toți Liderii de Arenă din Kanto. A venit să-mi țină companie.

en: Celio
Pleased to meet you! I'm Celio. I'm trying to link the PCs here on the islands with the PCs back in Kanto.
text: Încântat de cunoștință! Sunt Celio. Încerc să leg PC-urile de pe insule cu PC-urile din Kanto.

en: But the machine just won't talk to Kanto's network. I've been stuck on it for weeks.
text: Dar mașinăria pur și simplu nu vrea să vorbească cu rețeaua din Kanto. Sunt blocat pe asta de săptămâni.

en: Bill
Leave it to me. Two heads are better than one, right? Let's see what's going on in there.
text: Lasă pe mine. Două capete gândesc mai bine decât unul, nu? Să vedem ce se întâmplă acolo.

en: Celio
Thanks, Bill! Oh, and {player}, you should see more of the islands while you're here. Please, take this.
text: Mulțumesc, Bill! Ah, și, {player}, ar trebui să vezi mai mult din insule cât ești aici. Te rog, ia asta.

en: With the Tri-Pass, the Seagallop will take you between Kanto and the first three islands, whenever you like.
text: Cu Tri-Permisul, Seagallop te duce între Kanto și primele trei insule, ori de câte ori vrei.

en: Bill
We'll be at this for a while. Say, {player}, could you run an errand for me while you look around?
was: O să ne ia ceva timp. Du-te și uită-te prin jur, {player}. Marinarul din port te poate duce înapoi în Kanto.

en: Go and have a look around, {player}. The sailor at the harbour can take you back to Kanto too.
That's a Meteorite. A fellow who runs the game corner on Two Island has been wanting one for ages.
Would you take it to him? Celio's been meaning to send it over, but he can't leave the machine.
Bill
{player}! You're back! Guess what? Celio and I got the machine talking to Kanto at last.
The PCs on the islands are linked with the ones at home now. My work here's done.
So I'm heading back to Kanto. Why don't you come along? I'll ride the Seagallop with you as far as Cinnabar.
Celio
Bill, {player}, thank you both. I couldn't have done it without you.
{player}, come back and see me anytime. There's still so much I want to try with this machine.
Bill
Hmm, what if I connect this here... No, that's not it either. Don't worry, we'll crack it!
text: Hmm, dacă leg asta aici... Nu, nici așa. Nu-ți face griji, o descurcăm noi!

en: Did you take the Meteorite to the game corner on Two Island yet? The Seagallop will get you there.
Oh, {player}! I almost forgot. Could you run an errand for me?
You've been all the way to Three Island? Then you've seen more of the islands than me! Take your time, the machine's nearly there.
Celio
Sorry, I'm in the middle of something. This machine is giving me no end of trouble.
was: Bill e un geniu. Cu ajutorul lui, sunt sigur că mașinăria se va lega de Kanto în scurt timp.

en: Bill's a genius. With his help, I'm sure the machine will link up with Kanto in no time.
was: Scuze, sunt la mijlocul unei treburi. Mașinăria asta îmi face numai probleme.

en: {player}, your Pokédex... it's been upgraded to the National Pokédex! Then you'll be meeting Pokémon from far and wide.
Here's the thing. I want to link this machine to networks much farther away than Kanto. But it needs more power.
There's a gem called the Ruby that holds the power I need. It's said to lie somewhere deep inside Mt. Ember, at the north end of this island.
I know it's a lot to ask, but could you look for it? I'd go myself, but I'm no match for the Pokémon on that mountain.
Thanks to Bill, the islands' PCs are linked with Kanto. Now I'm trying to make the machine reach even farther.
That glow... It's the Ruby! You found it on Mt. Ember? Thank you, {player}!
Now, there's one more thing I need. Could I ask one more favour of you?
Will you help me again?
There's said to be another gem, the Sapphire, somewhere on the islands farther south. With both, the machine will be complete.
This pass will help. Take it in place of your Tri-Pass.
With the Rainbow Pass, the Seagallop will take you to all seven islands. I'm counting on you!
Oh... Please think it over, {player}. You're the only one I can ask. Keep the Ruby safe until then.
The Ruby should be somewhere deep inside Mt. Ember. Please be careful on that mountain!
The Sapphire should be on one of the islands farther south. The Seagallop will take you there with the Rainbow Pass.
